notes.title: 1.7.0 EA
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone, welcome to the version update for 1.7.0 EA. Salt Player for Windows will continue to improve the user experience.[/p][p][/p][h3]新增文件夹页面[/h3][p][/p][p]Added a Folder page to the sidebar. Folders are displayed in a tree structure, and clicking on an option allows you to view the songs in that folder (excluding subfolders):[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038670/0bc93dd82b82cf24413343fc903f6c89719d0f9c.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]New Playlist and Songlist Drag-and-Drop Feature[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Playlists now support dragging and dropping with the mouse to adjust the order of songs. Additionally, songlists in the sidebar can also be rearranged via drag-and-drop.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Feature to Remove Individual Items from the Play Queue[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]You can now click the remove button on the right side of a song in the play queue to remove it from the queue. Combined with the playlist drag-and-drop feature, the play queue experience has been significantly enhanced.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038670/0ff5300b1d240b0d648dc53bf84f7d96743a21be.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Auto-Hide Mouse Pointer Feature in the Playback Screen[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]The mouse pointer will now automatically hide after remaining stationary for a short period in the playback interface. This feature is enabled by default and can be turned off in the accessibility settings.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038670/ba52637515bb9c6ddb9fa216d3454c9d013b5b8b.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Optimizations[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Optimized the search and play function so that it no longer replaces the entire play queue[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Fixes[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where desktop lyrics might display outside the screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the song progress would show 00:00/00:00 when a song was loaded but not played[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where playback might freeze when automatically skipping to the next song due to slow buffering[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed other minor issues[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 1.6.20 EA
notes.notes: [p][/p][h3]3D Cover Effect[/h3][p][/p][p]Hovering over the album cover in the playback interface triggers a rotation and shadow animation:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038670/d0829370f95e138a20de4c5633c85df91c8f8425.png"][/img][/p][h3]Optional Circular Playback Cover[/h3][p][/p][p]This feature can be toggled in ​[b]Settings > Appearance > Playback Screen[/b]:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038670/40a07e33197eeae9819fe73358367aaf2dbfec0f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038670/8dc794e0c968a904f39a092bf95fa485ba907d75.png"][/img][/p][h3]Lyrics Floating Animation[/h3][p][/p][p]Word-by-word lyrics now feature an elegant floating effect：[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038670/a6c4047ceb20de4e5deb09f579b1e11bd275c8be.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Other Additions[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Added compatibility adjustments for certain special artists[/p][/*][*][p]Added independent alignment settings for desktop lyrics[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Mod API 0.1.0-dev10 Update[/h3][p][/p][p]For details, see the release notes on GitHub: [url="https://github.com/Moriafly/spw-workshop-api"]https://github.com/Moriafly/spw-workshop-api[/url][/p][p][/p][h3]Changes[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Removed the ​[b]RAW[/b]​ quality badge[/p][/*][*][p][b]DSD[/b]​ audio no longer displays any badge[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Fixes[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where locating certain songs in File Explorer could fail[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a potential freeze when scanning ​[b].dff[/b]​ files[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the mini player bar would briefly flash the playback interface background on startup[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where multi-select shortcuts wouldn't respond after the first use of checkbox song selection[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Salt Player for Windows[/p]

notes.title: 1.6.10 EA
notes.notes: [h3][b]SPW Audio Quality Badges[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Added new badges: "HQ", "CD", "CD+", "HiRes", and "RAW". A full music library rescan is required for these to take effect:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038670/b613bf4e33e9c8da5aa7d9ea29b33fa654f07a73.png"][/img][/p][p]If undesired, these badges can be disabled in the "Track Item" appearance settings:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038670/0329b5f4ba4e7fa5c387e1ba51a92f8a26aabc25.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Auto-hide Mini Player Controls[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Added a new "Auto-hide mini player controls" option (located in the Accessibility settings):[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038670/bb150e72bfa984c9e1303308714e779a41d87271.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Mouse Wheel Volume Adjustment[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Added the ability to quickly adjust volume using the mouse wheel over the volume button on the mini player:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038670/e4fb1bdd74f3f73080913d5a63265b86288ae461.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Japanese and Korean Localization[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038670/f58b42db266daafb2c40fd5d1510dbe4dc2a0cab.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Other New Features[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Added a "Copy file path" option to the track item context menu[/p][/*][*][p]Added a dB conversion hint for the volume control[/p][/*][*][p]Added support for scanning and playing DSD files (with extensions .dff/.dsf)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Optimizations and Changes[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Optimized Traditional Chinese, Russian, and Indonesian localizations[/p][/*][*][p]Changed default behavior so that newly added Mods are initially disabled[/p][/*][*][p]Deprecated the use of the disabled.txt file within the workshopmod folder[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Fixes[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the artist field in SMTC (System Media Transport Controls) might not update correctly[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 1.6.0 EA Changelog
notes.notes: [h3]Added Checkboxes for Song List Selection[/h3][p][/p][p]SPW's song list has always supported Ctrl for single selection, Shift for range selection, and other shortcuts similar to Windows Explorer, but many users were unaware of this. Now, checkboxes are displayed by default to clearly indicate that multi-selection is supported.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038670/bef5855bce37803f01a46f848159deeb67cd4886.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]If you don't like this feature, you can disable it. The setting is located in "Appearance" -> "Track Item Appearance". You can also access it via the right-click context menu in the song list.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038670/d8ffb01396c4ad531c9b8ced8cc00b53986fa72c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Remember Desktop Lyric Position[/h3][p][/p][p]SPW can now remember the last adjusted position of the desktop lyrics, so it will be restored the next time you launch the application.[/p][p][/p][h3]Other New Additions[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Added the ability to delete modules[/p][/*][*][p]Added a confirmation dialog for deleting playlists[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Optimizations and Changes[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Optimized the clarity of album art on the album interface[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized the layout of the lyrics settings interface for a more logical categorization and added a preview for the blur effect on non-current lyrics[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized the rendering speed of the sunglow effect[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the -restartsteam parameter for the Steam version as it is no longer in use[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the input format check for creating and editing playlists was incorrect[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where minimizing the window while maximized and then reopening it would cause it to become a floating window[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where parsing certain formats caused incorrect truncation of track titles[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where seeking in lyrics could not return to the initial, pre-playback state[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in WASAPI playback mode where pausing and then switching tracks could leave residual sound[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several other minor issues[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Steam Offline Usage Instructions[/h3][p][/p][p]By default, Steam creates a shortcut on your desktop with the address steam://rungameid/3009140, which launches the application through Steam. If you need to use it offline, you must run the executable file directly. To do this, go to your Steam Library, right-click on "Salt Player for Windows", select "Manage" -> "Browse local files". In the folder that opens, you will find "Salt Player for Window.exe". You can create a shortcut to this file and place it on your desktop.[/p]

notes.title: 1.5.20 EA Released! Sunglow Effect, Image Loading Overhaul, and More
notes.notes: [h3][b]Sunglow Effect Returns!​[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]The "Sunglow" effect, which was added in the test version but later disabled, has made a comeback. Compared to the test version, GPU usage has been optimized, though it remains a relatively GPU-intensive feature. As a result, it is disabled by default. The Sunglow effect is similar to the mobile version's "Streamer Light" effect but with some improvements. Feel free to try it out! The toggle can be found in ​[b]Settings → Appearance → Playback Interface[/b]:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038670/45b2201835648a134ca17d6efa84fbad37ac1d73.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]More Right-Click Menu Navigation Options[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Added navigation options in the song right-click menu to jump to ​[b]Album[/b], ​[b]Album Artist[/b], and ​[b]Performing Artist[/b]:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038670/dc204cb44f2e3ea2777282c08fbd7237c388bbec.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Image Loading Overhaul[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]The new version significantly improves image loading speed, including enhanced performance for indexed-color PNGs and interlaced PNGs, as well as better thumbnail display quality. Additionally, the rendering speed for progressive JPEG embedded covers has been increased by dozens of times. Support for embedded WEBP images has also been added.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]SPW Workshop API Update[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Refer to the updates in ​[b]SPW Workshop API 0.1.0-dev08[/b]:[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://github.com/Moriafly/spw-workshop-api"]https://github.com/Moriafly/spw-workshop-api[/url][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Desktop Lyrics Improvements[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Optimized desktop lyrics to remain visible above the taskbar[/p][/*][*][p]Improved outline visibility for desktop lyrics in light backgrounds[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced text display when no song or lyrics are available[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Other Optimizations and Fixes[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Improved cover animation in the playback interface when switching songs[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced accessibility display scaling, now adjustable down to ​[b]90%​[/b]​ with a minimum step of ​[b]1%​[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Improved default playback interface appearance for songs without covers[/p][/*][*][p]Refined some text descriptions[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the default setting for multi-layer blur to ​[b]enabled[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where genre tags would not clear automatically[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where log files were not automatically cleaned up[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where desktop lyrics displayed window icons in the taskbar[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Thank you for supporting Salt Player for Windows![/b][/p]

notes.title: SPW 1.5.10 EA Released! Search Function, Perfect Sample Rate, and More!
notes.notes: [p]We are delighted to present the SPW 1.5.10 EA version update! This update combines both aesthetics and functionality.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Note: The song information displayed in the images used for this update is for demonstration purposes only.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Search Functionality[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Added a song search feature in the song interface. This search function is now available across multiple pages, including the Songs page, Albums page, Artists page, Playlist content page, and Genre content page![/p][p][/p][p]The search box features a sleek animation—hovering over it will smoothly expand the box, and moving the cursor away will naturally collapse it:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038670/d3ff424609c002743ff10b6225ffa4fb2d5b7fed.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Additionally, transitions for song positions in the list now include refined animations.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Unreadable Track Notifications[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]SPW retains song records, but frequent prompts about missing tracks due to large-scale folder movements can be frustrating. Manually handling each one is also cumbersome for some users. However, preserving song information remains important.[/p][p][/p][p]The new ​[b]​"Unreadable Track Notification"​[/b]​ feature will now display a reminder in the title bar. Clicking this notification will take you to a dedicated interface where you can efficiently manage songs with broken file links, as shown below:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038670/7550076832684603743d399ab9d3a4b857e9c6dd.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Perfect Sample Rate in WASAPI Exclusive Mode (BETA)​[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Added ​[b]adaptive sample rate switching[/b]​ in WASAPI Exclusive Mode. When enabled, the output sample rate will automatically match the file's sample rate. If the file's sample rate is unsupported by the device, it will request a compatible format.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Note: Enabling this feature may cause slight stuttering during track switches due to audio hardware reconnection, and gapless playback will be temporarily disabled.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038670/a38b58a3a1bacfd878b41975c66ccfb70c96687a.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Multi-Select Count Indicator in Song Lists[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]When selecting multiple items, the list will now display a clearer indicator at the bottom-left corner showing the number of selected items:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038670/aee9ecbe5889f424230dff6a6ca7be52559b9727.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Quick Sample Rate Display on Mini Player Bar[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]The mini player bar now provides a quick view of the current ​[b]input, mixing, and output sample rates[/b], helping you monitor whether resampling is active:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038670/d539e65a160bb0314504c95f7cc6c978099b5e33.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Other Optimizations and Changes[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Optimized[/b]​ audio file loading scheduling in background threads to reduce track-switching stutter.[/p][/*][*][p]​[b]Optimized[/b]​ song list behavior—clicking blank areas (within the page) now deselects items.[/p][/*][*][p]​[b]Refined[/b]​ UI details and improved compatibility with special artist names.[/p][/*][*][p]​[b]Enhanced[/b]​ smoothness when switching between DirectSound and WASAPI modes.[/p][/*][*][p]​[b]Improved[/b]​ responsiveness when toggling WASAPI Exclusive Mode and dithering.[/p][/*][*][p]​[b]Temporarily disabled[/b]​ the sound effects feature pending future customization updates.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the app would freeze for a period after remote connection loss.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed lag caused by Dolby Atmos (DDP) extension loading errors.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect UI width in empty song and other interfaces.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where some WAV files without DISC NO metadata failed to import into the library.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed delayed updates in the Artists content view after adding new songs.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected several text translation issues.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Thank you for your continued support of Salt Player for Windows!​[/b][/p]

notes.title: 1.5.0 EA Released, Added Playlists, Rich Presence Feature, and More
notes.notes: [p]A huge thank you to everyone for your incredible support of the Steam version of Salt Player for Windows! I've received a great deal of feedback since our Early Access launch. This regular update introduces the highly anticipated playlist feature and other improvements. I hope you enjoy it! Here are the details:[/p][h1]Highlights: Playlists[/h1][p]SPW now features a "New Playlist" button in the sidebar. Simply enter a playlist name and an optional description to create a new playlist.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038670/5a8cfe329c2e683ddd2a3e1a2bb4e8e7429fcaa4.png"][/img]You can drag and drop songs into playlists. Select a single track, or use Ctrl to select multiple individual tracks and Shift to select a range of tracks (similar to Windows File Explorer). When you drag songs, a gray border will appear around the playlist area. This border will highlight when you hover over a specific playlist, indicating you can drop the songs to add them. A confirmation message will appear at the bottom if the songs are added successfully.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038670/166fd7a757f51eb3e7ed132ba7f40a3c4e628bb7.png"][/img]By default, songs within a playlist are sorted in reverse chronological order of when they were added. When adding multiple selected songs, they will maintain their selection order. The album art of the first song selected will become the playlist cover. If that song is already in the playlist, the system will try the next song in the selection.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038670/371580fd101f92bec8e31b8d30c5db12089ffce5.png"][/img]The right-click context menu is still available for songs within a playlist, with the new option "Remove from the playlist". You can also select and remove multiple songs at once.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038670/2fa42576fdd1eb6f8bd20131f566849b05ae3a6f.png"][/img][b]Note on the "Remove from Library" function:[/b] Removing a song from your Music Library will also remove it from all playlists.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038670/41b371ba664ddb24e22f72b3e7ff912f01d4472d.png"][/img][/p][p]Custom sorting for playlists is not yet supported but is planned for a future update.[/p][h1]Highlight: Rich Presence[/h1][p]Added support for Steam's Rich Presence feature. The song you are currently listening to will now be displayed in your friends' list (format: "Artist - Title"; if the artist is not available, only the "Title" will be shown).[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038670/18207a04940e92bd61805c38f758d0ea147ce497.png"][/img][/p][p]If you prefer not to use this feature, you can disable it at any time in [b]Settings -> Steam Account[/b] by turning off the "Rich Presence: Now Playing" option.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038670/08cb338eaa652e5ddd3506e574dd794d0580445c.png"][/img][/p][h1]Full Changelog[/h1][h2]New[/h2][list][*][p]Added the Playlist feature.[/p][/*][*][p]Added parsing for audio properties of CDA files, including duration and track number.[/p][/*][*][p]Added support for dragging multiple files simultaneously in the song list.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new Rendering settings page that displays the current GPU model.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a "Learn More" help section for the "Music Library."[/p][/*][*][p]Added functionality for side mouse buttons to navigate to the previous page or exit the playback screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a "Lyric Alignment" option, allowing lyrics to be left-aligned.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Steam Rich Presence feature: "Now Playing."[/p][/*][/list][h2]Optimizations and Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Optimized the layout of the Settings interface.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized the layout of the "About Open Source Projects" page.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized the Lyrics settings interface.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized the shadow effect for album items on the Album page.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized the lyric loading process during rapid song switching to reduce performance overhead.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the "Early Access" section from the Settings interface.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a potential crash that could occur when dragging and dropping files to scan.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the currently playing track's data did not refresh after modifying the play queue.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where importing CDA files from the Music Library interface would fail.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a scanning issue where files with non-standard extensions (e.g., uppercase ".FLAC") were not recognized during folder drag-and-drop or scanning.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a sorting issue where the list order would not change when selecting ascending/descending with a small number of songs sorted by title.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where menu text would be cut off after applying a custom font.[/p][/*][*][p]Other miscellaneous optimizations and fixes.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you again for your support. If you have any feedback or suggestions, please feel free to leave a message on our Steam Community Hub, Discussions, or GitHub.[/p][p]Salt Player for Windows[/p]

[*] Fix the system tray garbled text issue
[/list]

notes.title: Salt Player for Windows Early Access launches on July 21
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p][/p][p]Salt Player for Windows has completed most of the preparations for its Early Access release on Steam. The Early Access version is scheduled to officially launch next Monday (July 21), with version number ​[b]1.4.20 EA[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]During the Early Access period, there will be a ​[b]15% discount[/b]​ lasting for ​[b]14 days[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]For the basic details about Early Access, please check the store page. Additionally, please note that the current version is still in early development and does not include features such as playlists (planned for ​[b]1.5 EA[/b]) or search functionality. You may also encounter some issues:[/p][p][/p][olist][*][p]The initial EA version relies on Steam to run, so please ensure the Steam process is active[/p][/*][*][p]If the Steam process is not running, launching SPW will not automatically wake Steam. You can add the -restartsteam launch parameter to enable automatic Steam wake-up. Note that this feature has not been extensively tested and may have compatibility issues[/p][/*][*][p]In Chinese language environments, you may encounter garbled text in the system tray's right-click menu. This has been documented and will be fixed in a future update[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]If you encounter any other issues while using the software, feel free to reach out to the developer:[/p][olist][*][p]Report bugs and leave feedback in the ​[b]Discussions[/b]​ section for this software[/p][/*][*][p]Submit an issue on the GitHub repository at: [url="https://github.com/Moriafly/SaltPlayerSource"]https://github.com/Moriafly/SaltPlayerSource[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Contact via email at ​[url="https://moriafly@163.com"]moriafly@163.com[/url][/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]Thank you for your support of ​[b]Salt Player for Windows[/b]​ from the ​[b]Salt[/b]​ product line![/p][p][/p][p]Zeshi Palace Studio Sakawish[/p]
